verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਲਖ ਬੇਮੁਖਾਂ ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਟ ਲਖ ਲੂਣ ਹਰਾਮੀ।
verses.translit_en: lakh ni(n)dhak lakh bemukhaa(n) dhoot dhusaT lakh loon haraamee|

en.bdb: Millions are slanderers, millions are apostates and millions of wicked persons are untrue to their salt.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਵਾਮਿ ਧੋਹੀ ਅਕ੍ਰਿਤਘਣਿ ਚੋਰ ਜਾਰ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਪਹਿਨਾਮੀ।
verses.translit_en: savaiaam dhohee akirataghan chor jaar lakh lakh pahinaamee|

en.bdb: Unfaithful, ungrateful, thieves, vagabonds and millions of other infamous persons are there.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਮ੍ਹਣ ਗਾਈਂ ਵੰਸ ਘਾਤ ਲਾਇਤਬਾਰ ਹਜਾਰ ਅਸਾਮੀ।
verses.translit_en: baamhan gaiee(n) va(n)s ghaat laitabaar hajaar asaamee|

en.bdb: Thousands are there who are slayers of Brahmin, cow, and their own family.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਪ ਲਖ ਗੁਨਹਗਾਰ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਬਦਨਾਮੀ।
verses.translit_en: kooRiaar gur gop lakh gunahagaar lakh lakh badhanaamee|

en.bdb: Millions of liars, prevaricators of the Guru, guilty and ill-reputed ones are there.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਬਹੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਲਖ ਅਵਗੁਣਿਆਰ ਖੁਆਰ ਖੁਨਾਮੀ।
verses.translit_en: aparaadhee bahu patit lakh avaguniaar khuaar khunaamee|

en.bdb: Many a criminal, fallen, full of demerits and phoney people are there.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਲਿਬਾਸੀ ਦਗਾਬਾਜ ਲਖ ਸੈਤਾਨ ਸਲਾਮਿ ਸਲਾਮੀ।
verses.translit_en: lakh libaasee dhagaabaaj lakh saitaan salaam salaamee|

en.bdb: Millions are there of variegated guises, cheats and friendly to Satan, exchanging greetings with them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਹਉ ਮੁਕਰਾ ਹਉ ਕਪਟੀ ਤੂੰ ਅੰਤਰਿਜਾਮੀ।
verses.translit_en: too(n) vekheh hau mukaraa hau kapaTee too(n) a(n)tarijaamee|

en.bdb: O God, you all know how I am denying (after having your gifts). I am a cheat and O Lord, you are omniscient.
O Master, you are uplifter of the fallen ones and your always keep your reputation.
